children: Signet Jewelers entered an accelerated share repurchase for $125 million and received ~1,023,000 initial shares.
The company paid $125 million to JPMorgan and received an initial delivery of ~1,023,000 common shares on Sept 11, 2026.
Final shares repurchased will be based on VWAP during the calculation period, subject to adjustments and possible cash/stock settlement.
Final settlement is expected between Sept 25, 2026 and Dec 2, 2026, but may be postponed, adjusted or terminated per agreement terms.
After this ASR, about $575 million of repurchase authorization remains under the 2017 program; further repurchases at company discretion.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
